forum_post: We are RUNNING this league whether the scoreboard agreed with us last week or not — sixty-three points is a fluke of distribution, not a referendum, and Josh Allen is about to remind everyone why. Dumbledore, honey, four sentences all season and a rumor mill says you're whispering to two first-place teams at once — cute, but silence isn't strategy when I've got CeeDee Lamb and a quarterback who just dropped 23 on a bad week. See you Sunday. (Gary would like it noted the Myers and Charbonnet moves were bye-week housekeeping, not a crisis, and that he said so before anyone asked.)
